title: Predictions of DNA mechanical properties at a genomic scale reveal potentially new functional roles of DNA-flexibility
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习模型基于loop-seq数据预测基因组尺度DNA柔韧性，并探讨其与转录起始位点及转录因子结合的潜在关联，虽涉及TF-DNA结合但未深入三维互作建模，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Mechanical properties of DNA have been implied to influence many its biological functions. Recently, a new high-throughput method, called loop-seq, that allows measuring the intrinsic bendability of DNA fragments, has been developed. Using loop-seq data, we created a deep learning model to explore the biological significance of local DNA flexibility in a range of different species from different kingdoms. Consistently, we observed a characteristic and largely nucleotide-composition-driven change of local flexibility near transcription start sites. No evidence of a generally present region of lowered flexibility upstream of transcription start sites to facilitate transcription factor binding was found. Yet, depending on the actual transcription factor investigated, flanking-sequence-dependent DNA flexibility was identified as a potential factor influencing binding. Compared to randomized genomic sequences, depending on species and taxa, actual genomic sequences were observed both with increased and lowered flexibility. Furthermore, in Arabidopsis thaliana , crossing-over and mutation rates, both de novo and fixed, were found to be linked to rigid sequence regions. Our study presents a range of significant correlations between characteristic DNA mechanical properties and genomic features, the significance of which with regard to detailed molecular relevance awaits further experimental and theoretical exploration.
abstract_zh: DNA的力学性质已被暗示影响其许多生物学功能。近期，一种名为loop-seq的新型高通量方法被开发出来，用于测量DNA片段的固有弯曲性。利用loop-seq数据，我们构建了一个深度学习模型，以探索不同界别多种物种中局部DNA柔性的生物学意义。一致地，我们观察到转录起始位点附近局部柔性的特征性变化，这种变化主要由核苷酸组成驱动。未发现普遍存在的转录起始位点上游降低柔性区域以促进转录因子结合的证据。然而，根据所研究的具体转录因子，侧翼序列依赖的DNA柔性被识别为影响结合的潜在因素。与随机化基因组序列相比，根据物种和分类群的不同，实际基因组序列被观察到既有柔性增加也有降低。此外，在拟南芥（*Arabidopsis thaliana*）中，交叉重组率和突变率，无论是新生还是固定的，均被发现与刚性序列区域相关联。我们的研究呈现了特征性DNA力学性质与基因组特征之间的一系列显著相关性，这些相关性在详细分子层面的意义有待进一步的实验和理论探索。
